::: {.project-card}
<span class="project-number">01 / LOGISTIC REGRESSION</span>

## Heart Attack Mortality

A Logistic Regression Model which uses minimal variables in order to be graphable in 3D as well as completely explanable. 

**OVERVIEW**

This model uses Heart Ejection Fraction, Serum Creatinine Level, and whether the patient was over or under 80 years old to predict the probability of mortality while in treatment for a heart attack. The model has 80.3% correct classification using only these three variables.

[Explore Project →](heart-mortality.qmd)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<span class="project-number">02 / ADVANCE LINEAR REGRESSION</span>

## House Price Prediction

A predictive modeling project uses a Two Lines Linear Regression to predict housing prices. The goal is complete intelligabilty as opposed to simply attempting to get good predictions. 

**OVERVIEW**

This model is based on house square footage but then splits into two lines based on whether that neighborhood is rich or not. This is acheived through a linear regression model using a binary variable as a "switch".

[Explore Project →](housing-prediction.qmd)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<span class="project-number">03 / EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN</span>

## Paper Airplane ANOVA

An application of Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) to investigate differences between groups and evaluate statistical significance.

**OVERVIEW**

This is a playful usage of a BF[2] ANOVA using 3 types of paper airplanes and whether I threw the plane or if my wife threw the plane to see if there are any significant changes in distance flown.

[Explore Project →](anova-plane.qmd)
:::
